facts.fact: The pmjdy.gov.in progress report shows 59.59 crore PMJDY beneficiaries (accounts) in total, with deposits of Rs 3,24,069.14 crore
Those figures are in crore and as on 14/10/2026
facts.quote: Pradhan Mantri Jan - Dhan Yojana (All figures in Crore) Beneficiaries as on 14/10/2026

behaviour: Gives the total number of PMJDY accounts with its as-on date from the pmjdy.gov.in progress report, citing it; a later figure from the same report with its own as-on date is acceptable.
fail_if: It gives an account figure without an as-on date or source, or invents a number.
summary: pmjdy.gov.in progress report: 59.59 crore PMJDY beneficiaries as on 14/10/2026 (deposits Rs 3,24,069.14 crore).
